In 2020, APsmart RSD device shipments surpassed 100MV and APsystems Microinverter cumulative shipments exceeded 1GW globally.

pangsa_pasar.kutipan: Greentech Media Research ranked APS number two in global microinverter suppliers by shipments in 2013.

kapasitas.kutipan: The $250 million plant, which will employ up to 1,500 people, is designed to assemble 20,000 solar panels a day, totaling 5 GW of annual production capacity.
Located about 30 miles from downtown Louisville, the one-million-square-foot project will initially have a capacity of 3 GWh, with a second phase expected to double production capacity.

isu_dagang.kutipan: Released in 2024, Canadian Solar’s 2023 Corporate Sustainability Report cited ongoing reductions in greenhouse gas emissions and energy, water, and waste intensities. === Controversies === In 2021, the Human Rights Foundation criticized Canadian Solar after The Globe and Mail reported that the company operated a solar farm in Xinjiang, China, near a Uyghur internment camp.
The Guelph Mercury Tribune later reported a second solar farm in Xinjiang with ties to a supplier of Canadian Solar.
The Globe also reported a 2019 agreement between Canadian Solar and polysilicon manufacturer GCL-Poly, a company whose Xinjiang subsidiary had ties to forced labor.
